note: ACKNOWLEDGED price-review flags. A flag listed here with a FUTURE `expires` date is not paged. Anything else pages: an ack with no `expires`, an unparseable one, or a past one is treated as EXPIRED, because silencing a price flag forever on the strength of a typo is exactly the failure the review-flag system exists to prevent. Read by check-ad-cycles.ps1; mirrors how coverage-ack.json works for coverage regressions. WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: before 2026-07-30 a flag that stayed open simply went quiet after its first page - last_seen was refreshed on every run, so the 7-day novelty test could never elapse. Being ignored long enough was indistinguishable from being reviewed. Now an open flag RE-ARMS after 14 days and an ack is the only way to make one quiet, with a date on which someone has to look again.
how_to_ack: Add { "key": "<the flag key from out\\alerted-flags.json>", "reason": "why this is not a bug - be specific, a future reader needs to re-verify it", "expires": "yyyy-MM-dd" }. Keep expiries short (weeks, not months): the expiry is the whole point, it forces the question again. Do NOT ack a flag you have not actually checked against the store.
